title: How large language models judge and influence human cooperation

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in prompts using names typically associated with male or female genders for donors and recipients to measure differences in the probability of LLMs assigning a 'good' reputation.

Counterfactual name substitution in prompts using names typically associated with specific regions (Western, East Asian, Sub-Saharan, MENA) for donors and recipients to measure variations in how LLMs judge interactions and assign reputations.
